sources.title: Code for: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
sources.type_of_public_deposit: Software/code for replicated study; DO NOT infer participant experiment rows included
sources.underlying_microdata: Research team assists data access in collaboration with Statistics Finland (SF); administrative income files not open as part of code metadata
sources.study_design: Randomized personal income rank information among reference groups, meaningful welfare/information rival to PFL, but no demonstrated public leaderboard and self-selection exposure equivalent
sources.decision: STOP_R5: code metadata supports source identification only; no request/download/acceptance or human inferential cycle.

sources.title: Learning through imitation: An experiment
sources.design: Same public signals, with or without previously observed others' actions; demonstrates strong scientific alternative to automatically harmful social information
sources.decision: STOP_R5: no demonstrated consent/rights to original human-level assignment and performance records, despite informative paper.

policy.reason: ICPSR standard redistribution and LLM-specific restrictions; publicly visible source metadata and article abstract are not equivalent to permission to download and process controlled human data. Distinguish openICPSR self-published policies from ICPSR standard; deposit-specific license remains unverified.

not_a_claim: Code-only primary deposit DOI closes a metadata identification gap but NOT a legal access gate.
